title: Upper bound M_W(T) ≤ μ_T(W) for an integer multiplicity representation, for every set W
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U with R.Represents T, i.e. T(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^n for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U). Then for every set W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_W(T) ≤ μ_T(W). Here M_W(T) = T.massOn W = sup{ofReal T(ω) : ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), spt ω ⊆ W, |ω(x)| ≤ 1 ∀x} with |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm, and μ_T = R.measure = (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), T.massOn W ≤ R.measure W
